description:
This file defines the Colors class within the ScssPhp
amespace, which provides static methods and data for mapping CSS color names to RGB values and vice versa. It appears to be part of an internal library for handling color representations in SCSS processing.

classes.name: Colors
classes.description: Provides static methods and a color name-to-RGB mapping for CSS colors, including conversion methods between color names and RGB(A).

methods.name: colorNameToRGBa
methods.description: Converts a CSS color name to an RGBA array if the name exists in the predefined color list.

methods.name: RGBaToColorName
methods.description: Returns the CSS color name closest to the given RGBA values if one exists and the alpha is 1.
